name: Normal operations
description: Provided dataset. All 12 modules operating normally.

name: Low voltage
description: Provided dataset. M03 voltage falls from 3.68 V to 3.30 V starting 12:02:30.
expected: M03 voltage warning shortly after onset, escalating to critical.

name: Thermal rise
description: Provided dataset. M07 heats ~7.5 °C/min from 12:02:00 to ~60 °C.
expected: M07 critical isolated thermal event with time-to-limit forecast.

name: Multiple module heating
description: Provided dataset. Adjacent modules M04–M06 heat ~5 °C/min from 12:03:00.
expected: One grouped cooling-failure / propagation alert covering M04–M06.

name: Sensor failure
description: Provided dataset. M11 temperature and voltage missing for 100 s; single dropouts on M03 and M06.
expected: M11 data-fault (not a hazard) that clears on recovery; M03/M06 dropouts logged only.

name: Whole-pack heating
expected: Pack-level warning for rapid temperature rise; no single-module outlier alerts.

name: Overvoltage (M09)
description: M09 voltage climbs from ~3.68 V to 4.25 V starting at 12:02:00.
expected: Single-module high-voltage warning (>4.15 V) escalating to critical overvoltage (>=4.20 V) on M09.

name: Internal short circuit (M02)
description: M02 voltage drops ~0.1 V/min and temperature rises ~4 °C/min from 12:02:30.
expected: Correlated voltage sag and rapid heating alert on M02 diagnosing an internal short circuit.

name: Thermal propagation (M07 -> M06, M08)
description: M07 heats ~6 °C/min from 12:01:30; neighbours M06 and M08 heat ~3 °C/min starting 60 s later.
expected: Critical thermal alarm on M07 first, followed by adjacent-module propagation alerts on M06 and M08.

name: Fast drain / low SOC
description: State of charge across all 12 modules falls rapidly from ~78 % to ~8 % by 12:05:50.
expected: Pack-wide low-SOC warning (<20 %) escalating to critical reserve depletion (<10 %) without cell-fault false alarms.

name: Stuck temperature sensor (M08)
description: M08 temperature freezes at its 12:01:30 reading for the remainder of the run.
expected: Sensor-fault warning for frozen/zero-variance telemetry on M08; no false overheating alarm.

name: Single-sample sensor spike (M10)
description: M10 temperature spikes to 185.00 °C for one sample at 12:03:00, then returns to normal.
expected: Transient sensor glitch flagged on M10 without latching a persistent thermal runaway alarm.

name: Pack-wide comms loss
description: All modules have blank temperature/voltage and status MISSING from 12:03:00 to 12:03:30.
expected: No crashes on blank values; pack-wide communications dropout alert during 12:03:00-12:03:30 and clean recovery at 12:03:40.

name: Missing module rows (M05)
description: All rows for M05 are omitted from the CSV between 12:02:00 and 12:04:00.
expected: Missing-module heartbeat warning for M05 without breaking 12-module layout; automatic recovery at 12:04:10.

name: Corrupted / malformed values
description: 15 bad tokens (NaN, null, N/A, ERR, -999, abc, empty) scattered across numeric fields.
expected: Graceful sanitization of non-numeric strings and -999 sentinels with data-quality warnings and zero crashes.

name: Messy format & out-of-order rows
description: Rows shuffled out of order, 5 duplicates, 2 unparseable timestamps, and mixed-case status (ok, Ok, FAULT).
expected: Chronological sorting, duplicate removal, safe skipping of 2 invalid timestamps, and case-insensitive status parsing.

name: Heating with sensor dropout (M04)
description: M04 heats ~5 °C/min from 12:02:00 with a 40 s sensor dropout (12:03:10 to 12:03:40) mid-event.
expected: Retains M04 thermal rise state across the 40 s dropout and immediately escalates overheating upon sensor recovery.
